name: Router carving
description: V-carve letters and logos, engrave lines, or carve a grey picture as a relief for a router or laser-class machine. The V-bit follows the middle of each shape at the depth its width needs; a flat mill clears wide floors; a cutter follows a depth map without cutting into it. G-code from a post-processor you can edit, and a check that reads any program back.
author: CadCraft
